name: Permanent Resident Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Held a Resident Visa for at least 2 years in a row, and either currently hold it or it expired within the last 90 days.
requirements.fix_path: Hold a Resident Visa continuously for 2 years.

requirements.blocker_text: Evidence of commitment to New Zealand -- the time-based method requires at least 184 days in each of the last 2 years in NZ (four alternative commitment methods exist besides this one).
Good character assessment, which may require police certificates, and compliance with existing Resident Visa conditions.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 2 years holding a Resident Visa
Travel records showing commitment to NZ (e.g. 184+ days/year)

outcome.duration_length: indefinite; no ongoing conditions once granted

sources.title: Immigration New Zealand -- Permanent Resident Visa: 2-year Resident Visa holding requirement, 5 alternative commitment-to-NZ evidence methods (184+ days/year modeled here), good character assessment, removes travel-condition expiry, ~80% processed within 2 weeks

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (New Zealand). This is the conversion step from a conditional Resident Visa (granted by nz_skilled_migrant_category.json, nz_partner_resident_visa.json, nz_active_investor_plus.json, or nz_parent_resident_visa.json) to unconditional permanent residence -- distinct from a first-instance PR grant. Four other commitment-evidence methods besides the 184-days/year figure exist (e.g. tax residency, ongoing NZ business) but were not independently detailed in this pass; the time-based method is modeled as representative since it was the one confirmed with an exact figure. citizenship_after_months (36) reflects that most Resident Visa holders will have already accrued much of NZ's 5-year/1,350-day citizenship clock (see nz_citizenship_by_grant.json) by the time they reach Permanent Resident Visa status at the 2-year mark -- modeled as an approximate remaining-time estimate, not a separate independent bar.
